Prawn Dumplings

Time: time
Servings: servings
Source: Google class
Tags: tested, savory, snack, main-course, medium-effort, fish, milk-free

Ingredients

  • 500g Ground shrimps
  • 3-4 Spring onions chopped
  • 20g Fresh coriander
  • 1-2 cloves Garlic, minced
  • 1⁄2 tsp Ginger, minced
  • 1⁄4 Red chilli
  • 1 egg
  • 3⁄4 tsp Pepper
  • 1⁄2 tsp Salt to taste
  • 2 tsp Sesame oil
  • 2 Tbsp Light Soy sauce
  • 1 Tbsp Cornstarch
  • 10 Sheets Gyoza wrappers defrosted

Instructions

  1. Peel and devein the prawns then pulse in a food processor (or chop up with a knife) until it resembles ground mince.
  2. Mix shrimp, onions and egg together.
  3. Season the remaining ingredients and add the corn starch to help bind the mix.
  4. Mix all the ingredients together and prepare for filling the wrappers.
  5. To form the dumplings, remove 1 gyoza wrapper from the package, covering the others with a damp cloth. Brush the edges of the wrapper lightly with water.
    Place 1/2 rounded teaspoon of the mixture in the center of the wrapper. Shape as desired. Set on a sheet pan and cover with a damp cloth. Repeat procedure until all of the filling is gone.
  6. Place a medium non-stick skillet on stove top, medium heat. Add oil to bottom of pan. Place dumpling in pan, let the bottom get crispy. Pour about 2 tablespoons water into pan. Place cover on top of pan. Let cook until water evaporates. Plate and serve with some dipping sauce.
